relations: Descending piston tip compresses the metallic case, causing the white housing to crack and crumble into debris.
While the case is crushed, the white silicone band remains roughly in place on the circular metal platform.
When the crush zone blurs, shattered fragments are ejected outward, scattering through the air and onto the platform.
As debris settles, a dark mass sits at the right tip edge, and a blue-green fragment protrudes left.
caption: The video captures a hydraulic press in operation, its dark cylindrical piston with a tapered lower tip bearing down on a white smartwatch laid flat on a circular metal platform. The watch's square metallic case sits directly beneath the tip, its white silicone band stretching left toward a metal buckle and right across the platform, against a fixed dark-green workshop wall with a cabinet. The piston descends slowly, and the contact point compresses the case, the surrounding white housing cracking and crumbling into a small pile of debris while the band remains roughly in place. A brief blur appears around the crush zone. Then a burst of shattered fragments, including a curved transparent shard and a greenish piece, is ejected outward with strong motion blur, scattering through the air and onto the platform. As the flying debris settles, a dark crushed mass sits at the right edge of the piston tip. A small blue-green fragment protrudes at the left edge of the compressed case, the piston still pressed firmly down.
